bundle.shortDescription: Desktop workspace for research papers, AKMS knowledge nodes and MechDSL
bundle.longDescription: Logic-Loom is a desktop workspace that gathers papers from Zotero, summarizes them, links them into an AKMS knowledge graph, and compiles MechDSL models.
